41.palette_note: With a palette: the sea runs through the palette's first half from offshore to the waterline, stretching with each wave, the sand through its second half along the beach; the foam is the sea, paled.

42.palette_note: With a palette: the sea runs through the palette's first half from offshore to the tide line, stretching with the tide, the sand through its second half along the strip; the foam is the sea, paled.

48.palette_note: With a palette: the glow runs through the palette along the strip, over a night sea of the same colours kept very dark.

49.palette_note: With a palette: the water runs through the palette from the top of the fall to the pool; foam, streaks and mist are those colours, paled.

65.palette_note: With a palette: the velvet runs through the whole palette along the strip and the worn patches reveal the colour opposite it beneath, still matte.

66.palette_note: With a palette: old traces and the dark glass run through the whole palette along the strip; fresh touches glow in the colour opposite.

82.palette_note: With a palette: the clouds run dark through the palette along the strip, shifting as they roll; rain and lightning light them up in their own colour.
